title: The Windsor Hum
hook: A low drone haunts Windsor for decades, and no one knows why
headline: The mysterious hum that rattles Windsor

description: Explore the decades-long mystery of the unexplained hum that haunts Windsor.

facts.claim: The Windsor Hum was first reported by residents in 1965.
A 1992 acoustic survey measured the hum at about 50 decibels near Windsor Castle.
In 2000, researchers suggested nearby industrial cooling fans might be the source.
A 2021 acoustic analysis proposed underground water flow as a possible cause, but the hypothesis remains unconfirmed.
